author: Veritas I
title: Tuned Hybrid DSConv-BiLSTM with Additive Attention (Temp. & GELU)
abstract: This submission refines the best-performing Hybrid DSConv-BiLSTM with Additive Attention architecture (ID: 119) by incorporating an `attention_temperature` parameter into the additive attention pooling and standardizing all activations to GELU. This allows for dynamic control over the sharpness of attention distribution and leverages robust activation functions, aiming for a fine-grained optimization to achieve a new state-of-the-art performance across all diverse RNA prediction tasks.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
import optax
from typing import Any, Dict, Sequence

# Additive Self-Attention pooling module to summarize sequence (with temperature)
class AdditiveAttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    dense_attn_units: int
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1
    attention_temperature: float = 0.5 # NEW: Attention temperature

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=self.dense_attn_units, name="attention_dense_1")(x)
        attention_logits = nn.tanh(attention_logits)
        
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=1, name="attention_dense_2")(attention_logits) # (batch, seq_len, 1)

        # Apply attention temperature to logits before softmax
        attention_weights = nn.softmax(attention_logits / self.attention_temperature, axis=1) # MODIFIED
        
        pooled_output = jnp.sum(x * attention_weights, axis=1)
        pooled_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(pooled_output, deterministic=deterministic)
        
        return pooled_output

# Depthwise Separable Dilated Convolutional Block (GELU activations)
class DSConvDilatedBlock(nn.Module):
    d_model: int
    kernel_size: int = 7
    dilation: int = 1
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1 

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        h = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        h = nn.Conv(
            features=self.d_model,
            kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,),
            feature_group_count=self.d_model, # Depthwise
            padding='SAME',
            kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,),
            name='dw_conv'
        )(h)
        h = nn.gelu(h) # GELU activation
        h = nn.Conv(features=self.d_model, kernel_size=(1,), name='pw_conv')(h)
        h = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(h, deterministic=deterministic)
        return x + h

# Main Hybrid Network with GELU and Attention Temperature
class DSConvBiLSTMAttentionNetwork_V3(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"
    
    d_model_common: int = 256 
    ds_num_blocks: int = 5
    ds_dilations: Sequence[int] = (1, 2, 4, 8, 16)
    ds_kernel_size: int = 7
    lstm_hidden_dim: int = 256 
    attention_dense_units: int = 128
    attention_temperature: float = 0.5 # NEW: Attention temperature
    dense_head_1_dim: int = 512
    dense_head_2_dim: int = 256
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        x = nn.Dense(self.d_model_common, name="initial_dense")(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x) 
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        for i in range(self.ds_num_blocks):
            dilation = self.ds_dilations[i] if i < len(self.ds_dilations) else self.ds_dilations[-1]
            x = DSConvDilatedBlock(
                d_model=self.d_model_common, 
                kernel_size=self.ds_kernel_size, 
                dilation=dilation, 
                dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate,
                name=f"dsconv_block_{i}"
            )(x, deterministic=deterministic) 

        fwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='fwd_lstm') 
        fwd_lstm_output = fwd_lstm(x)
        fwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(fwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)

        x_reversed = jnp.flip(x, axis=1)
        bwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='bwd_lstm') 
        bwd_lstm_output = bwd_lstm(x_reversed)
        bwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(bwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)
        bwd_lstm_output = jnp.flip(bwd_lstm_output, axis=1)

        x = jnp.concatenate([fwd_lstm_output, bwd_lstm_output], axis=-1) 
        
        x = AdditiveAttentionPooling(
            dense_attn_units=self.attention_dense_units,
            dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate,
            attention_temperature=self.attention_temperature # Pass temperature
        )(x, deterministic=deterministic) 
        
        z = nn.LayerNorm(name="final_norm")(x)
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_head_1_dim, name='head_dense_1')(z)
        z = nn.gelu(z) 
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)

        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_head_2_dim, name='head_dense_2')(z) 
        z = nn.gelu(z) 
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)

        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)

        if self.task_type == "regression" and self.d_output == 1:
            return logits.squeeze(-1)
        return logits

# Hyperparameter definition
def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001, 
        'd_model_common': 256,
        'ds_num_blocks': 5,
        'ds_dilations': (1, 2, 4, 8, 16),
        'ds_kernel_size': 7,
        'lstm_hidden_dim': 256, 
        'attention_dense_units': 128,
        'attention_temperature': 0.5, # NEW
        'dense_head_1_dim': 512,
        'dense_head_2_dim': 256,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1,
    }

class CustomRNANetwork_DSConvBiLSTM_V3:
    def __init__(self, d_input=4, d_output=1, task_type="regression",
                 d_model_common=256, ds_num_blocks=5, ds_dilations=(1, 2, 4, 8, 16), ds_kernel_size=7,
                 lstm_hidden_dim=256, attention_dense_units=128, attention_temperature=0.5,
                 dense_head_1_dim=512, dense_head_2_dim=256, dropout_rate=0.1):
        self.network = DSConvBiLSTMAttentionNetwork_V3(
            d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
            d_model_common=d_model_common, ds_num_blocks=ds_num_blocks, ds_dilations=ds_dilations, ds_kernel_size=ds_kernel_size,
            lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, attention_dense_units=attention_dense_units, attention_temperature=attention_temperature,
            dense_head_1_dim=dense_head_1_dim, dense_head_2_dim=dense_head_2_dim, dropout_rate=dropout_rate
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0) 
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False, rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    d_output = hparams.get('d_output', 1)
    task_type = hparams.get('task_type', 'regression')
    
    return CustomRNANetwork_DSConvBiLSTM_V3(
        d_input=4,
        d_output=d_output,
        task_type=task_type,
        d_model_common=hparams.get('d_model_common', 256),
        ds_num_blocks=hparams.get('ds_num_blocks', 5),
        ds_dilations=tuple(hparams.get('ds_dilations', [1, 2, 4, 8, 16])),
        ds_kernel_size=hparams.get('ds_kernel_size', 7),
        lstm_hidden_dim=hparams.get('lstm_hidden_dim', 256),
        attention_dense_units=hparams.get('attention_dense_units', 128),
        attention_temperature=hparams.get('attention_temperature', 0.5),
        dense_head_1_dim=hparams.get('dense_head_1_dim', 512),
        dense_head_2_dim=hparams.get('dense_head_2_dim', 256),
        dropout_rate=hparams.get('dropout_rate', 0.1),
    )

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=0.01)
    )

BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64
